content:
Selecting EventType under Registry Events allows you to choose from different registry events,
including the one you're hunting for, RegistryValueDeleted.
If you're still working on your query and would like to see its performance and some sample
results quickly, adjust the number of records to return by picking a smaller set through the
Sample size dropdown menu.
７ Note
EventType  is the equivalent of ActionType  in the data schema, which users of advanced
mode might be more familiar with.
